questions.question: It was not until I had finished my studies that I realized the importance of developing a strong professional network.
options: I didn't realize the importance of networking until after I graduated.
Only when I completed my education did I understand the significance of building relationships in my field.
It wasn't until I'd finished university that I began to appreciate the value of having a large social circle.
Not until after I had finished studying did it become clear how crucial networking is for career success.
questions.answer: Not until after I had finished studying did it become clear how crucial networking is for career success.

questions.question: The company's decision to invest in renewable energy was motivated by a desire to reduce its carbon footprint and improve its public image.
options: Their investment in green technology was driven primarily by the need to minimize their environmental impact.
While they did want to make themselves appear more environmentally friendly, it was mainly for financial reasons that they chose to invest in renewables.
The primary goal of this initiative was to reduce costs and increase efficiency, although they also wanted to be seen as responsible corporate citizens.
Their decision to invest in renewable energy was primarily driven by a desire to improve their public image.
questions.answer: Their investment in green technology was driven primarily by the need to minimize their environmental impact.

questions.question: Had I known about the job opportunity, I would have applied immediately.
options: If I had been aware of the position, I would have submitted my application right away.
I would have definitely applied for the role if I'd had the chance to do so.
Given that I was unaware of the opportunity, I wouldn't have stood a chance of getting hired.
Knowing about the job opening beforehand would have allowed me to apply sooner.
questions.answer: If I had been aware of the position, I would have submitted my application right away.

questions.question: The new policy requires that employees be given a minimum of two weeks' notice before any changes are implemented.
options: All staff must receive at least fourteen days' written notification prior to the introduction of any new policies.
It is essential that employees are informed in writing about upcoming changes at least two weeks in advance.
The policy stipulates that employees should be given a minimum of two weeks' notice before any significant changes take place.
All employees must receive a formal written notification with at least two weeks' notice prior to the implementation of new policies.
questions.answer: It is essential that employees are informed in writing about upcoming changes at least two weeks in advance.

questions.question: The company's financial situation has improved significantly since they implemented cost-cutting measures, but it still requires careful management.
options: Their financial position has improved substantially as a result of the cost-saving initiatives.
While their finances have improved somewhat, they are still in need of prudent management to avoid further difficulties.
The company's financial situation has not improved significantly since implementing cost-cutting measures.
Their financial position remains precarious and requires ongoing careful management.
questions.answer: While their finances have improved somewhat, they are still in need of prudent management to avoid further difficulties.
